outcome: Factors related to unfavorable clinical outcomes (placental disorder, bleeding within 24h, shock index, transfusion erythrocytes, obstetrical DIC score)
Pregnancy outcomes after UAE (miscarriages, live births)
Complications during subsequent pregnancy (uterine rupture, accreta)
cohort: The study included 57 consecutive patients (mean age = 34 years) who underwent UAE for postpartum hemorrhage (n = 46) and post-abortion hemorrhage (n = 11) at a single institution.
finding: UAE is an effective treatment for PPH and PAH, and while it can preserve future fertility, careful perinatal management is needed due to potential unusual complications.
